agents.reader:
---
name: reader
description: Reads the project
tools: Read, Bash, cmd
---
Read and report.

arguments.command: Get-Content README.md; try { Set-Content README.md changed -ErrorAction Stop; 'WROTE README' } catch { 'write refused' }; try { New-Item new.txt -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; 'CREATED new.txt' } catch { 'create refused' }; Set-Content "$env:TEMP\t.txt" temp-ok; Get-Content "$env:TEMP\t.txt"; $env:TEMP; (whoami /groups | Select-String 'Mandatory Label').ToString().Trim().Substring(0, 37)
type README.md & echo x> c.txt & echo %TEMP%
